title: Why it sucks being the coach

scenes.text: Why it sucks being the coach.
It starts when nobody else volunteers. Now you own twenty bibs, thirty cones... and a group chat with forty parents.
Saturday, seven a.m. You're the first one there. You put up the nets. In the rain.
Match day. Fifteen players. Eleven positions. Fifteen parents who think their kid should start.
You lose 3-0? "Bad tactics." You win 3-0? "Great players."
Second half. A dad on the sideline shouts different instructions. Louder than you.
Half-time. You prepared the perfect speech. First question: "Can we have orange slices?"
End of the season. They win the league! Everyone gets in the team photo. You're the one holding the camera.
That's the thing about being the coach. No money. No thanks.
And next Saturday... you're there at seven again.
Tag your coach. Tell them thank you.
